item.title: Revolution Oncology Titan
item.description:
• Summary: Truist analysts argue that Revolution Medicines could become the next oncology titan, citing the company's pipeline of RAS‑targeted therapies. The analysis highlights the potential of Revolution's RAS‑on multi‑inhibitors in addressing a broad range of RAS‑mutant cancers. No specific clinical data were discussed in the article.

  • Sources: BioSpace

item.title: Mammogram Conflicting Advice
item.description:
• Summary: A STAT News article explores the conflicting advice women receive about when to start mammogram screening. Different organizations recommend starting at ages 40, 45, or 50, with varying frequencies. The piece explains the evidence behind each guideline, the trade-offs between benefits (early detection) and harms (false positives, overdiagnosis), and how women can make informed decisions based on their individual risk factors.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: STAT News
